headline: Cameco Shares Decline After Third-Quarter Financial Earnings Miss Estimates
summary: Cameco shares fell after the company reported third-quarter 2026 financial results that missed analyst expectations.
why: Cameco is one of the world's largest commercial producers of uranium fuel for nuclear power plants.
